# hg topology

**What this page tells you:** every `hg topology` subcommand, with its arguments, flags and defaults.

Compile the declarations against an environment, no cluster.

## Synopsis

```text
hg topology inspect [flags]
hg topology plan [flags]
hg topology urls [flags]
hg topology print [flags]
hg topology doctor [flags]
hg topology emit [flags]
```

`--json` prints one JSON document on stdout; narration goes to stderr.

## Description

Compiles the repo's declarations against an environment topology, offline. `emit` materializes `catalog/` + `deployments/` into a GitOps repo (refuses on errors). `--layout` simulates a different layout without touching the file.

## `hg topology inspect`

```text
hg topology inspect [flags]
```

Validated declarations only.

| Flag | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--dir` | `<repo-path-or-git-url>` | — | The persona/distribution repository to read declarations from. |
| `--environment` | `<file>` | — | The cluster half, overriding the repo's own: a legacy `topology.yaml`-shaped file (targets inline), or an environment spec (`infra/environments/<env>.yaml`) whose `grants` supply targets, DNS, policy and capability providers for the team's target-free `harness-hg/topology.yaml`. Team files (bundles, communication, capabilities) always come from the repo's `harness-hg/` (legacy: `environment/`). |

**Examples**

```bash
hg topology inspect --dir ../my-team
hg topology doctor --dir .
```

## `hg topology emit`

```text
hg topology emit [flags]
```

Materialize catalog/ + deployments/ into a gitops repo.

| Flag | Value | Default | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--dir` | `<repo-path-or-git-url>` | — | The persona/distribution repository to read declarations from. |
| `--environment` | `<file>` | — | The cluster half, overriding the repo's own: a legacy `topology.yaml`-shaped file (targets inline), or an environment spec (`infra/environments/<env>.yaml`) whose `grants` supply targets, DNS, policy and capability providers for the team's target-free `harness-hg/topology.yaml`. Team files (bundles, communication, capabilities) always come from the repo's `harness-hg/` (legacy: `environment/`). |
| `--output` | `<gitops-dir>` | — | The GitOps repo to write into (alias `--repo`). |
| `--repo` | `<gitops-dir>` | — | Alias of `--output` (the DevX-contract spelling). |
| `--source` | `<repo-path-or-git-url>` | — | Alias of `--dir` (the DevX-contract spelling). |
| `--router-image` | `<image>` | — | Environment knob written as a top-level chart value beside spec. |
| `--observer-url` | `<url>` | — | Debug observer URL the router mirrors lifecycle records to. |
| `--argo-destinations` | `<mode>` | — | How Argo CD destinations are written into the emitted applications. |
